native.purpose: Material 2021 headline/title/body/label roles; preserve system text scaling and wrapping, no remote font.

project-title.purpose: Native titleLarge with weight 600; app-bar titleLarge also uses 600.

reading.purpose: Roboto body roles; authored extended reading line-height 1.5.

editor.purpose: System monospace with authored line-height 1.5, native editing and IME.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.value: shadow (4dp,4dp), blurRadius 10dp, alpha .7; highlight (-4dp,-4dp), blurRadius 10dp, alpha .55
shadows.purpose: NeoSurface raised using brightness-specific neutral shadow/highlight colors.

shadows.name: compact
shadows.value: shadow (2dp,2dp), blurRadius 5dp, alpha .7; highlight (-2dp,-2dp), blurRadius 5dp, alpha .55

shadows.name: inset
shadows.value: shadow (3dp,3dp), alpha .6; highlight (-3dp,-3dp), alpha .65; MaskFilter blur sigma 3dp
shadows.purpose: Clipped even-odd native interior painter; sigma is not CSS blur radius.

shadows.name: flat
shadows.purpose: Reading planes and disabled native button depth.

motion.name: route-forward
motion.purpose: Retained custom route fade/slide; zero under disableAnimations.

motion.name: route-reverse
motion.purpose: Retained reverse route transition; zero under disableAnimations.

motion.name: route-easing
motion.purpose: Existing route easing; reduced motion returns child directly.

motion.name: route-translation
motion.purpose: Fraction of child width; checkpoint routes use Offset(0.045, 0).

motion.name: project-layered-stack
motion.purpose: Restore upright overlapping project neighbors with finite clamp and side N-stop slider; no up/down buttons or presentation selector. Transform/opacity cached real cards; stable exact-ID selection and all-session panel, interaction/lifecycle/input/a11y gates preserved.

motion.name: day-night-switch
motion.purpose: Reference-matched controlled native sun/moon cover, concentric rings, descending clouds and entering four-point stars; reduced/keyboard/assistive immediate.

motion.name: working-avatar
motion.purpose: Live connection plus connected writer plus workState running/background only; never human_wait, settled or disconnected. Reduced motion is static with text; offscreen/inactive ticking stops. No new animation.

native.acceptance: Source-derived record only; historical captures are not redesign acceptance. No test or native runtime acceptance is asserted here.
native.colorGeneration: ColorScheme.fromSeed #a87920 with authored overrides; remaining roles including errors are SDK-generated. No wallpaper Dynamic Color.
native.surfaceRoles: surface/scaffold/canvas=base; low/high=raised; lowest/highest/secondaryContainer=inset; onSurface/onSecondaryContainer=text; onSurfaceVariant/secondary=secondary text; onSecondary=base; tertiary=primary; onTertiary=base
native.stateDetails: Fields: resting outlineVariant, focused amber 2dp, disabled outlineVariant alpha .5; error uses native error role. Cursor/handles amber, selection alpha .24. Button border focused primary, disabled outlineVariant alpha .4, otherwise alpha .55. Divider outlineVariant alpha .65. Native state layers and callbacks remain intact.
native.previewPolicy: No HTML/CSS preview included; this sidecar is documentation, not a second implementation or browser acceptance baseline.

components.name: Native affirmative action
components.description: FilledButton: 48x52dp minimum, radius 16dp, amber/onPrimary while enabled. backgroundBuilder uses compact raised at rest, inset pressed/selected, flat disabled; native semantics, focus and ink response retained.

components.name: Native secondary action
components.description: OutlinedButton uses the neutral native neumorphic backgroundBuilder, 48x52dp minimum and radius 16dp. TextButton is 48x48dp minimum, radius 12dp. Compact/icon control minimum is 48x48dp.

components.name: Inset field
components.description: NeoInputBorder with native InputDecorator, inset fill, 16dp radius/padding and 2dp amber focus. Preserve floating labels, accessible names, validation, multiline selection and IME. Composer retains persistent OMP’ye mesaj name and anchored input/send row.

components.name: Native navigation
components.description: Projeler/Gelen kutusu/Ayarlar: native NavigationBar or labeled NavigationRail at 720dp. Inset 16dp indicator, amber selected labels/icons, native Back and destination semantics. App-bar elevation and scrolled-under elevation zero.

components.name: Native selected filter
components.description: Raised resting, inset selected, base disabled; radius 12dp, padding 8dp, outlineVariant side and native amber checkmark. Wrapping remains available.

components.name: Native contextual surfaces
components.description: NeoSurface default radius 20dp; menus raised 16dp; dialogs/sheet top corners raised 24dp with outlineVariant border and native confirmation/dismissal. Keep long transcripts/files/diffs flat. Snackbars use text background/base content.

narrative.overview: Explicitly requested whole-app graphite/fog neumorphism replaces the previous visual world. One amber action accent and top-left lighting serve a Turkish-first, local-first native companion for project continuity, conversations and human decisions. Source-derived documentation is not native acceptance; canonical implementation report owns evidence.
keyCharacteristics: One neutral lighting model with raised, inset and flat depth
Native Roboto/Material roles and system text scale
Quiet flat reading planes and true inset inputs
Actual project/source/paired-PC identity, freshness and connection state
rules: First valid desktop or phone response wins; disconnected decisions are not silently queued.
Only pending, connected, valid, non-submitting requests are actionable; closed/expired requests stay read-only.
Keep source-session identity and durable memory distinct from live activity; finished turns are not finished projects.
Preserve draft ownership, acknowledged-version clearing, multiline growth, safe-area and IME anchoring.
Keep file/diff inspection read-only, diagnostics redacted, local Markdown free of remote fetches; host enforces project path confinement.
dos: Resolve brightness-specific semantic pairs through the theme
Keep native callbacks, touch targets, labels, focus and pressed/disabled states
Show status/failure/freshness in words as well as color
Retain reduced-motion and inactive/offscreen stop rules
Use canonical report for current acceptance and historical evidence
donts: Do not imply wallpaper Dynamic Color or invent an authored tonal ramp
Do not add colored glows, decorative imagery or new looping animation
Do not wrap every reading paragraph in raised decoration
Do not substitute previews or historical screenshots for current native acceptance
Do not change trust, source, permission, privacy or first-response boundaries through styling
